T-001.Title: Move the ngrace-spec instrument tokens and land the supersede-path sentences in both trees

AcceptanceCriteria.Criterion: The instrument moves first: `TAUGHT_RULES` in `scripts/check-teaching-surface.ts` and its twin in `scripts/check-teaching-surface.test.ts` gain one entry each for `{ngrace-spec, shape_sources, "overwriting the minted skeleton"}`, `{ngrace-spec, shape_sources, "carried verbatim"}` and `{ngrace-spec, acceptance_criteria_anchors, "predecessor's archive arrival"}`. Before the skill text lands, `bun run validate:teaching-surface` exits non-zero naming the missing token — the recorded red. Then `skills/ngrace/ngrace-spec/SKILL.md` and `plugins/ngrace/skills/ngrace/ngrace-spec/SKILL.md` land the three sentences: the "Lineage path" paragraph states that `spec new --supersedes` mints a throwaway skeleton and the successor is authored by overwriting the minted skeleton from the archived predecessor's bytes with `status` reset to `draft` and the verb-inserted `Replacement` child dropped; it states that the `mint-search` line printed while the predecessor is still active is carried verbatim by whatever consumes it later and never re-derived after the move; and `acceptance_criteria_anchors` adds the predecessor's archive arrival to every archive-edit exclude, with its reason. Both trees carry the same bytes.
`bun run validate:teaching-surface` exits 0 and `bun test --timeout=0 scripts/check-teaching-surface.test.ts` passes after the sentences land.

T-002.Title: Replace the stale ngrace-plan validation token, add its new tokens, land the plan sentences in both trees

AcceptanceCriteria.Criterion: The two `TAUGHT_RULES` lists drop `{ngrace-plan, validation, "requires an open epoch on a declared task"}` and add `{ngrace-plan, validation, "does not require an open epoch"}`, `{ngrace-plan, approved_plan_immutability, "status reset to draft"}` and `{ngrace-plan, must_do, ".git/info/exclude"}`. Removing a token is not a red; the red for the rewrite is the new token demanded before the corrected sentence exists. Then `skills/ngrace/ngrace-plan/SKILL.md` and its mirror land three sentences: `approved_plan_immutability` gains the overwrite-reset-drop mechanic beside "archived predecessor's draft"; `must_do` row 19 gains that a faithful post-close copy carries `.git` and that an ignored directory reached through a symlink needs a bare `.git/info/exclude` entry; and `validation` is rewritten to say `--run-commands` does not require an open epoch while the true phrases ("requires a declared task in scope" behaviour and `assertion.change-required`) stay present.
`bun run validate:teaching-surface` exits 0 and the twin test passes.

T-003.Title: Replace the stale ngrace-execute token, add the exec tokens, land the exec sentences in both trees

AcceptanceCriteria.Criterion: The lists drop `{ngrace-execute, assertion_commands, "needs an open epoch on a declared task"}` and add, in lockstep across both files: `{ngrace-execute, assertion_commands, "exits non-zero"}`, `{ngrace-execute, assertion_commands, "does not require an open epoch"}`, `{ngrace-execute, assertion_commands, "selected-baseline lint"}`, `{ngrace-execute, execution_rules, "gate.apply.no-verdict"}`, `{ngrace-execute, execution_rules, "does not open a fresh epoch"}`, `{ngrace-execute, execution_rules, "hidden by the default severity"}`, `{ngrace-execute, cursor_kinds, kind attempt, "review.attempt-pair-unpaired-pass"}`, `{ngrace-execute, cursor_kinds, kind attempt, "namespace import"}`, `{ngrace-execute, cursor_kinds, kind attempt, "opens a new epoch"}`, and `{ngrace-execute, cursor_kinds, kind terminal, "stays on the last task"}`. Then both ngrace-execute trees land the sentences: the final-query asymmetry in `assertion_commands`; the apply-verdict ordering in rule 9; the corrected `--run-commands` task resolution in `assertion_commands` and rule 7 (rewritten in place, so "opens a fresh epoch" is gone while "after a fold, final run-commands writes loose events" stays); the selected-baseline `MODULE_MAP` instrument in `assertion_commands`; the info-level pass-only finding in the `attempt` kind and rule 13; the namespace-import guard in the `attempt` kind; and the correction's new epoch and the end-state terminal on the last task in kinds `attempt` and `terminal`.
`bun run validate:teaching-surface` exits 0 and the twin test passes.

T-004.Title: Add the ngrace-reviewer instrument token and land the xmllint trap sentence in both trees

AcceptanceCriteria.Criterion: Both lists add `{ngrace-reviewer, review_judgment, "silently under-counts"}`; the red is that token demanded before the sentence exists. Then `skills/ngrace/ngrace-reviewer/SKILL.md` and its mirror state, beside the read-the-shape-first bullet, that a structural census of XML artifacts goes through the shipped parser because `xmllint` rejects a document whose comments contain `--` and silently under-counts; the existing "read the shape first" and "shipped parser" text stays.
`bun run validate:teaching-surface` exits 0 and the twin test passes.

T-007.Title: Run the universality checks, confirm the conditional pins, and end the run with the terminal event on this task

AcceptanceCriteria.Criterion: Run `checkRecordTokens` over the four skills in both trees (it runs inside `bun run validate:teaching-surface`) and report its exit; grep the four rewritten skills in both trees for the forbidden classes the scanner does not cover — harness install paths, `scripts/` file or identifier names, repository-private function names, bundle ids and record file names — and report the count.

Grep the four conditional pin files (`scripts/skill-contracts.test.ts`, `src/review/core.test.ts`, `src/grace-cursor.test.ts`, `src/artifact/grammar.test.ts`) for the passages T-002 and T-003 rewrite and for the phrases the spec's Constraints require to stay; repair a pin only if the executed teaching falsified it, at the same matcher strength. Report the grep and whether any repair was needed.

This task is the last one: after its verification passes, the operator emits the terminal cursor event on itself (`ngrace cursor advance --change C-TEACHING-CLOSE-PATH-1-3E91B69F --task T-007 --kind terminal`) before the final fold, so the close's fold has a range closer.
